remarks:
A rare opportunity for recreation opportunities, scenic views looking over to Swain Ski Resort, and future potential with this exceptional  vacant land parcel including approximately 27 acres located in the scenic hills of the Town of Grove, Allegany County. Offering road frontage on both State Route 70 and England Hill Road, this versatile property provides outstanding accessibility along with multiple potential building locations where you can take advantage of picturesque views toward Swain Ski Resort. There is electric and internet available along the road frontage on State Route 70, but not England Hill Road. 
Whether you're planning to build a year-round residence, seasonal cabin, or private recreational retreat, this property offers the flexibility to bring your vision to life. Existing trails weave throughout the land, making it easy to explore the property's diverse terrain while enjoying hiking, ATV riding, wildlife watching, or hunting. The mixed woodland also presents the opportunity for future timber management, providing long term investment potential in addition to recreational enjoyment. Outdoor enthusiasts will appreciate being surrounded by some of Western New York's finest public lands and attractions including, but not limited to Swain Ski Resort, over 5,000 acres of Rattlesnake Hill Wildlife Management Area just minutes away, the "Grand Canyon of the East" Letchworth State Park, Stony Brook State Park, Keeney Swamp State Forest, Ossian State Forest, and the nearby Finger Lakes Trail System. 
Conveniently located yet surrounded by natural beauty, this property offers an outstanding opportunity for those seeking a homesite, recreational getaway, hunting property, or long term land investment. With excellent road frontage, scenic views, established trails, abundant wildlife, and valuable timber potential, this is a property that can be enjoyed today while continuing to grow in value for years to come.
Don't miss your chance to own this beautiful Allegany County acreage in one of the Southern Tier's premier outdoor recreation destinations. All Rights will convey.
